propositions: Plan and code review currently use independent discovery paths that allow inconsistent policy application, disabled built-ins, omitted criteria, and incorrect checkpoint interpretation.
Implement unified discovery architecture with immutable repository-bound effective-policy snapshot that both gates derive from, retaining gate-specific strategies and verdict policies.

Migrate code-review LLM criteria to require non-empty repository-relative glob list with ["**"] as repository-wide convention, and audit all documentation and config references to remove stale empty-list semantics.
Implement `rebar review-plan --retry` CLI subcommand that reuses content-identical successes, retries only missing calls with fresh budget, and refuses stale lineages before any model call.
Preserve gate-specific execution semantics (code-review sequential/no-checkpoint vs plan-review chunked/concurrent/cached) while moving to digest-complete success-only checkpoint namespace.
Persist versioned typed discovery trace for audit and diagnostics separate from narrow review-status response contracts.
